text: Our core tracks are Phonics (ages 3–10), Grammar (ages 5–10) and Public Speaking (ages 5–12). Each track has progressive lessons tailored to your child’s level. Classes are personalised in a 1:1 format so tutors can focus on individual strengths and gaps.

title: How Tiny Steps Works
text: We begin with a free assessment to find the right level. After assessment, you pick a track and package. Classes run 1:1 online for 35 minutes each, scheduled at convenient times. Tutors provide simple progress notes after sessions and suggest next steps. You can switch tracks or adjust pace as needed.

title: Why Tiny Steps
text: Tiny Steps focuses on small, consistent wins. Our 1:1 teaching model ensures personalised attention, faster progress and confident learners. We design lessons for early childhood and primary years using play-based, age-appropriate activities. Parents get clear updates and simple goals after each class.

title: Curriculum Overview
text: The curriculum builds key skills in reading, writing, speaking and listening. Phonics covers letter sounds, blending and early reading (ages 3–10). Grammar teaches sentence structure and writing basics (ages 5–10). Public Speaking develops confidence, storytelling and presentation skills (ages 5–12). Lessons are broken into short, focused activities to match a 35-minute class.
